decision: Approve the exact D5 proposal recorded in reports/PHASE_8_REMAINING_BLOCKERS_B2_B7_DECISION_REVIEW.md (SHA-256 f8d441a4e98bdc73ebcb7405acff02fc7221969a0aa1217ff7f88cfe2e6d3771): authorise the pilot-scoped training of six F and Fbeta readout artifacts on the frozen biological substrate, exactly six artifacts over the three declared evaluation seeds, twenty episodes per artifact, using the D4 B3/B4/B5/B6 training contracts. This decision authorises these six training runs and nothing else. It does not authorise E or E-full, a confirmatory campaign, a Pilot 2-C episode, a floor replay, a randomized graph, or any change to a frozen parameter, statistical constant, hypothesis or protocol document. It discharges no open item and selects no sample size.

owner_decisions.text: Authorise F and Fbeta training on the frozen biological substrate for the exact six (condition, evaluation seed) artifacts below, at twenty episodes per artifact, for a total of one hundred and twenty training episodes. No other condition, seed or episode count is authorised.

Use the D4 B3 derivation to pair evaluation seeds 9001, 9002 and 9003 with training seeds from the declared pool. Verified from the on-disk contract: 9001 maps to 1008 (pool index 7), 9002 maps to 1014 (pool index 13), and 9003 maps to 1005 (pool index 4). F and Fbeta at one evaluation seed share the derived training seed and each receives its own independent artifact.

Use the D4 B4 derivation for training environment seeds, the D4 B5 per-episode checkpoint policy with full retention, and the D4 B6 exact-resumption components and verification. No training episode uses a Pilot 2-C evaluation environment seed.
Write the six trained artifacts under experiments/results/phase_8/training only, with origin="trained" and stage="trained". A synthetic fixture is never an experimental artifact.
Preserve design.n_seeds_selected = null. U7 remains open. N stays at 16 primary. No confirmatory sample size is selected and no dispersion is estimated.
Do not modify REV4, D1, D2, D3 or D4; do not change any hypothesis, contrast, statistical constant or frozen neural parameter.

scope.checkpoint_history: every intermediate and the final checkpoint retained
scope.resume_policy: resume only from a verified checkpoint with full state restored and equivalence verified

prohibitions: do not train any condition other than F and Fbeta
do not train any evaluation seed other than 9001, 9002 and 9003
do not use a training seed other than the D4 B3 derivation
do not run more or fewer than twenty episodes per artifact
do not construct, read or substitute a randomized graph
do not run a Pilot 2-C episode or a floor replay
do not run E, E-full or a confirmatory campaign
do not start training if a relevant test fails
do not change a frozen parameter to force training to succeed
do not silently restart an interrupted artifact under a different seed
do not lower a resource threshold or reduce the approved workload
do not claim equivalence without a demonstrated comparison
do not modify REV4, D1, D2, D3 or D4
do not change a hypothesis, contrast or statistical constant
do not discharge U7 or set design.n_seeds_selected
do not write a trained artifact outside experiments/results/phase_8/training
do not treat a synthetic fixture as an experimental artifact
does_not_authorise: any change to a frozen parameter, statistical constant, hypothesis or protocol document
any change to D1, D2, D3 or D4
authorises: the six exact F and Fbeta training runs listed in authorised_artifacts
one hundred and twenty training episodes on the frozen biological substrate
the D4 B3/B4/B5/B6 training contracts for those runs
writing six trained artifacts under experiments/results/phase_8/training
certification and preflight of those artifacts that execute no Pilot 2-C episode
